failure_reason: Site-wide Cloudflare Turnstile managed-challenge block at every access tier. robots.txt (https://www.laredoute.fr/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow, so tier (c) was not pre-excluded by robots, but tier (c) (Claude-in-Chrome) is confirmed disconnected per task instructions (list_connected_browsers empty) and was not usable regardless. Tier (a): curl with Chrome UA -> HTTP 403, response header Cf-Mitigated: challenge, Server: cloudflare (homepage and /sitemap.xml both returned the same 403 challenge shell, Content-Length ~651KB, title 'La Redoute'). Retried tier (a) with curl_cffi impersonate='chrome124' (full Chrome TLS/JA3 fingerprint) -> still HTTP 403 with Cf-Mitigated: challenge. Tier (b): Playwright headless Chromium -> HTTP 403, page title 'Just a moment...', Turnstile widget present in DOM. Retried headed Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled -> same 403 'Just a moment...' Turnstile page. Retried against the real installed Chrome via channel='chrome' with the same anti-detection flag -> same 403 'Just a moment...' Turnstile page. No SSR nav markup, __NEXT_DATA__, mainnav, or megamenu content was ever reachable at any tier - only the Cloudflare interstitial shell. Per hard rules, did not attempt to solve/bypass the Turnstile CAPTCHA challenge. This matches the identical outcome already recorded for the sister site La Redoute UK (SR82), which was also fully Cloudflare-blocked at every tier.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt fetched cleanly (no Claude bot disallow) but is irrelevant here since the block is a Cloudflare Turnstile managed challenge in front of the entire site, not a robots directive. Attempted tier (a) direct HTTP (curl with realistic Chrome UA against / and /sitemap.xml; then curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 for TLS-fingerprint bypass) - both blocked with 403 + Cf-Mitigated: challenge on every request. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright: headless bundled Chromium (blocked, 'Just a moment...' Turnstile), headed bundled Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled (blocked, same), headed real installed Chrome via channel='chrome' with the same flag (blocked, same). Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was confirmed disconnected before starting per task instructions and is a last resort only for genuine ambiguity/anti-bot walls, not for solving CAPTCHAs, which is explicitly prohibited. TREE: no category tree could be built - zero navigation markup was ever served, only the Cloudflare interstitial HTML shell (same title 'La Redoute' / 'Just a moment...' on every route tried, ~651-652KB of challenge-page boilerplate with embedded webfonts, no mainnav/megamenu/__NEXT_DATA__ present). QTY: not applicable, no pages reached. EXCLUDED: nothing was classified because no nodes were ever observed. This is an honest full-site block, consistent with the sister site La Redoute UK (SR82) which received the identical treatment and was marked fully blocked with zero rows.
